resources.string: Secure, browser-to-browser screen broadcasting via WebRTC.
Lower resolution & frame rate to save data
Share this secure link with your viewer:
Screen capture permission is required to broadcast
Allow LayerLink to display over other apps to show a floating Stop control while broadcasting

1. LayerLink needs permission to display over other apps, so it can show a floating Stop control while a broadcast is live. You will be asked for this automatically the first time you start a broadcast.

2. Tap "Initialize Broadcast" and allow the screen-capture prompt that follows.

3. Share the generated link with your viewer — copy it or use the share button.

4. Status changes to "Connection Live" once your viewer opens the link.

5. To end the session, tap "Stop Broadcast" in the app, or tap the small floating dot anywhere on your screen and confirm — no need to reopen the app.
Your screen is being shared. Tap Stop in the app to end it.
